defects.what: The map under the lens has pseudo-text labels in its top corner, along the left edge and lower left.
The printer standing in the middle of the shop has a completely blank face with no eyes, nose or mouth.
The pamphlet stack at bottom left and the stacks on the shelves show pseudo-title lettering.
The boy jumping into the time vortex at center has a green t-shirt and messy brown hair with no topknot, red headband or medallion, and the dog beside the girl has no red kerchief.
A paper in the top-right corner shows large letters like 'E' and 'H'.
Small pseudo-letters appear on the map at the top left corner and right edge near the second magnifier.
The silver coins in the open palm are stamped with modern-looking glyphs like '0' and 'J'.
A rounded screen or UI-frame corner sticks into the bottom-left edge of the picture.
The flagpole on the Quezon City school roof flies a plain red pennant instead of the Philippine flag.
The black dog beside M has no red kerchief, both ears flopped, and a white tag-like disc in place of the chest patch.
Usman's close-up shows both ears standing straight up instead of one folded ear.
The boy in the red headband seen from behind has reddish-brown hair with no topknot, and the dog has no red kerchief.
Indio seen from behind has brown hair with no topknot, and the dog wears a red harness instead of a kerchief.
Indio wears a brown zip jacket, belt and jeans instead of his cloak or one of his set outfits, and no medallion shows.
Indio walking away on the shore has loose brown hair with no topknot or red headband.
